history.en: Conceived in 1911 by Maharaja Krishnaraja Wodeyar IV and legendary chief engineer Sir M. Visvesvaraya to alleviate regional droughts. Completed in 1932, the dam was built entirely using 'surkhi mortar' (a local mixture of limestone and brick powder) instead of cement, making it a masterpiece of early 20th-century Indian engineering.
history.kn: ಮೈಸೂರಿನ ಮಹಾರಾಜ ನಾಲ್ವಡಿ ಕೃಷ್ಣರಾಜ ಒಡೆಯರ್ ಮತ್ತು ದಿವಾನ ಸರ್ ಎಂ. ವಿಶ್ವೇಶ್ವರಯ್ಯ ಅವರ ದೂರದೃಷ್ಟಿಯಿಂದ 1911 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಯೋಜಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಈ ಜಲಾಶಯ 1932 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡಿತು. ಸಿಮೆಂಟ್ ಬದಲು ಗಾರೆಯನ್ನು (ಸುರ್ಖಿ ಗಾರೆ) ಬಳಸಿ ಇದನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
history.hi: 1911 में मैसूर के महाराजा कृष्णराज वोडेयार IV और मुख्य अभियंता सर एम. विश्वेश्वरैया द्वारा सूखा राहत के लिए परिकल्पित। 1932 में तैयार हुआ यह बांध सीमेंट के बिना केवल 'सुर्खी गारे' से बना एक ऐतिहासिक अजूबा है.
history.te: కృష్ణరాజ సాగర్ డ్యామ్ (కెఆర్ఎస్) మైసూర్ మహారాజు కృష్ణరాజ వోడియార్ IV మరియు సర్ ఎం. విశ్వేశ్వరయ్యలచే 1911లో రూపకల్పన చేయబడి 1932లో పూర్తయింది. ఈ డ్యామ్ నిర్మాణంలో సిమెంట్‌కు బదులుగా సుర్ఖీ మోర్టార్ ఉపయోగించారు.
history.ta: கிருஷ்ணராஜ சாகர் அணை (KRS) 1911 ஆம் ஆண்டு மைசூர் மகாராஜா கிருஷ்ணராஜ உடையார் IV மற்றும் புகழ்பெற்ற பொறியாளர் சர் எம். விஸ்வேஸ்வரய்யா ஆகியோரால் திட்டமிடப்பட்டு 1932 இல் கட்டப்பட்டது. இது சிமெண்டிற்கு பதிலாக சுர்கி சாந்து கொண்டு கட்டப்பட்டது.
history.ml: കൃഷ്ണരാജ സാഗർ ഡാം (KRS) മൈസൂർ മഹാരാജാവ് കൃഷ്ണരാജ വോഡയാർ IV, പ്രശസ്ത എഞ്ചിനീയർ സർ എം. വിശ്വേശ്വരയ്യ എന്നിവരുടെ നേതൃത്വത്തിൽ 1911-ൽ വിഭാവനം ചെയ്ത് 1932-ൽ നിർമ്മിച്ചു. സിമന്റിന് പകരം സുർഖി മിശ്രിതമാണ് ഇതിനായി ഉപയോഗിച്ചത്.

hours.ta: தினமும் காலை 6:30 முதல் இரவு 9:00 மணி வரை

flowPath.en: Outflow discharges downstream into the Cauvery River, passing through Srirangapatna and Shivanasamudra Falls before entering the Stanley Reservoir at Mettur Dam in Tamil Nadu.
flowPath.kn: ಹೊರಹರಿವು ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿ, ಶ್ರೀರಂಗಪಟ್ಟಣ ಮತ್ತು ಶಿವನಸಮುದ್ರ ಜಲಪಾತಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮಿಳುನಾಡಿನ ಮೆಟ್ಟೂರು ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟನ್ನು ತಲುಪುತ್ತದೆ.
flowPath.hi: बाहरी बहाव कावेरी नदी के माध्यम से बहते हुए श्रीरंगपट्टनम और शिवनासमुद्र जलप्रपात से गुजरते हुए तमिलनाडु के मेट्टूर बांध में प्रवेश करता है।
flowPath.te: కావేరి నది ద్వారా దిగువకు ప్రవహించి, శ్రీరంగపట్నం మరియు శివసముద్రం జలపాతాల మీదుగా తమిళనాడులోని మెట్టూరు డ్యామ్‌ను చేరుకుంటుంది.
flowPath.ta: நீர் வெளியேற்றம் காவேரி ஆற்றில் கலந்து, ஸ்ரீரங்கப்பட்டினம் மற்றும் சிவசமுத்திரம் நீர்வீழ்ச்சிகளைக் கடந்து தமிழ்நாட்டின் மேட்டூர் அணைக்குச் செல்கிறது.
flowPath.ml: പുറത്തേക്കുള്ള ഒഴുക്ക് കാവേരി നദിയിലൂടെ ശ്രീരംഗപട്ടണം, ശിവനസമുദ്രം വെള്ളച്ചാട്ടം വഴി തമിഴ്നാട്ടിലെ മേട്ടൂർ അണക്കെട്ടിലേക്ക് ഒഴുകുന്നു.

history.en: Completed in 1934 under British Rule (designed by Colonel W. M. Ellis), the Mettur Dam (Stanley Reservoir) is one of the oldest and largest gravity dams in India. It serves as the primary agricultural lifeline for the Cauvery Delta region.
history.ta: பிரிட்டிஷ் ஆட்சிக் காலத்தில் (கர்னல் டபிள்யூ. எம். எல்லிஸ் வடிவமைப்பில்) 1934 இல் கட்டி முடிக்கப்பட்ட மேட்டூர் அணை (ஸ்டான்லி நீர்த்தേக்கம்) இந்தியாவின் பழமையான மற்றும் மிகப்பெரிய ஈர்ப்பு அணைகளில் ஒன்றாகும். இது காவிரி டெல்டா விவசாயத்தின் உயிர்நாடியாகும்.
history.kn: ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ 1934 ರಲ್ಲಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಗೊಂಡ ಮೆಟ್ಟೂರು ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು (ಸ್ಟ್ಯಾನ್ಲಿ ಜಲಾಶಯ) ಭಾರತದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಹಳೆಯ ಮತ್ತು ದೊಡ್ಡದಾದ ಗುರುತ್ವಾಕರ್ಷಣೆಯ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದು ಕಾವೇರಿ ಮುಖಜ ಭೂಮಿಯ ಕೃಷಿಗೆ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಆಧಾರವಾಗಿದೆ.
history.hi: ब्रिटिश शासन के तहत 1934 में बनकर तैयार हुआ मेट्टूर बांध (स्टैनली जलाशय) भारत के सबसे पुराने और सबसे बड़े गुरुत्वाकर्षण बांधों में से एक है। यह कावेरी डेल्टा क्षेत्र के किसानों की जीवन रेखा है।
history.te: బ్రిటిష్ కాలంలో 1934 లో నిర్మించబడిన మెట్టూరు డ్యామ్ (స్టాన్లీ రిజర్వాయర్) భారతదేశంలోని అత్యంత పురాతనమైన మరియు అతిపెద్ద డ్యామ్‌లలో ఒకటి. ఇది కావేరి డెల్టా వ్యవసాయానికి ప్రధాన ఆధారం.
history.ml: ബ്രിട്ടീഷ് ഭരണകാലത്ത് 1934-ൽ പൂർത്തിയാക്കിയ മേട്ടൂർ അണക്കെട്ട് (സ്റ്റാൻലി റിസർവോയർ) ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ഏറ്റവും പഴയതും വലുതുമായ അണക്കെട്ടുകളിൽ ഒന്നാണ്. ഇത് കാവേരി ഡെൽറ്റ മേഖലയിലെ കാർഷിക ആവശ്യങ്ങൾ നിറവേറ്റുന്നു.

hours.ta: தினமும் காலை 9:00 முதல் மாலை 6:00 மணி வரை
hours.hi: प्रतिदिन सुबह 9:00 से शाम 6:00 बजे तक

fountain.en: N/A (Lush park is open for sightseers)
fountain.hi: लागू नहीं (पार्क पर्यटकों के लिए खुला है)

flowPath.en: Outflow continues along the Cauvery River, irrigating the fertile delta farmlands of Salem, Erode, Trichy, and Tanjavur before discharging into the Bay of Bengal.
flowPath.ta: நீர் வெளியேற்றம் காவிரி ஆறு வழியாகச் சென்று சேலம், ஈரோடு, திருச்சி மற்றும் தஞ்சாவூர் டெல்டா விவசாய நிலங்களை நனைத்து வங்காள விரிகுடாவில் கலக்கிறது.
flowPath.kn: ಹೊರಹರಿವು ಕಾವೇರಿ ನದಿಯ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಾಗಿ ಸೇಲಂ, ಈರೋಡ್, ತಿರುಚಿರಾಪಳ್ಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಂಜಾವೂರು ಕೃಷಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶಗಳನ್ನು ತಲುಪಿ ಬಂಗಾಳ ಕೊಲ್ಲಿಯನ್ನು ಸೇರುತ್ತದೆ.
flowPath.hi: जल निकासी कावेरी नदी के साथ आगे बढ़ते हुए सलेम, इरोड, त्रिची और तंजावुर के कृषि क्षेत्रों को सींचते हुए बंगाल की खाड़ी में गिरती है।
flowPath.te: కావేరి నది ద్వారా ప్రవహించి సేలం, ఈరోడ్, తిరుచిరాపల్లి మరియు తంజావూరు వ్యవసాయ భూములను తడుపుతూ బంగాళాఖాతంలో కలుస్తుంది.
flowPath.ml: പുറത്തേക്കുള്ള ഒഴുക്ക് കാവേരി നദിയിലൂടെ സേലം, ഈറോഡ്, തൃച്ചി, തഞ്ചാവൂർ എന്നീ കാർഷിക മേഖലകളെ നനച്ച് ബംഗാൾ ഉൾക്കടലിൽ ചേരുന്നു.

kabini.history: Built in 1974, the Kabini Dam is a critical reservoir in the Cauvery basin. Located near the border of the Nagarhole National Park, it is highly popular for wildlife tourism and supplies drinking water to Mysuru and Bengaluru.

map.flowPath: Outflow joins the Cauvery River at Tirumakudal Narasipura and flows downstream into Tamil Nadu.

harangi.history: Completed in 1982 near Kushalnagar in Kodagu. The Harangi Dam is the first reservoir built across a tributary of the Cauvery River in Karnataka, facilitating extensive farming in the Western Ghats region.

map.flowPath: Outflow joins the Cauvery River near Kudige, passing downstream to feed the main KRS reservoir.

hemavathy.history: Completed in 1979 near Gorur. A major reservoir constructed across the Hemavathy River, a key tributary of Cauvery. It is famous for its beautiful park and the nearby submerged Shettihalli Rosary Church.

map.flowPath: Flows downstream into the Cauvery River system, merging near KRS Dam.

tungabhadra.history: Built in 1953 by legendary engineer Thirumala Iyengar. A multipurpose dam serving irrigation, electricity generation, and flood control for Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh. Famous for its multi-colored lighting and Japanese gardens.

map.flowPath: Flows into the Tungabhadra River, joining the Krishna River near Alampur in Telangana, and downstream to Srisailam and Nagarjuna Sagar dams.

bhadra.history: Completed in 1965 near Lakkavalli. A major multi-purpose reservoir designed by Sir M. Visvesvaraya. Surrounded by the scenic Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.

map.flowPath: Outflow joins the Tunga River at Kudli to form the Tungabhadra River.

almatti.history: Completed in 2005. Officially named the Lal Bahadur Shastri Dam, it is the main reservoir of the Upper Krishna Project. Famous for its terraced gardens and boating.

map.flowPath: Outflow travels down the Krishna River towards Narayanpur Dam and Srisailam Dam.

idukki.history: Completed in 1973. A double curvature arch dam, one of the highest arch dams in Asia. Constructed between two granite hills, Kuravan and Kurathi.

map.flowPath: Outflow is directed through underground pipes to the Moolamattom Power House, then discharges into the Nachar River.

kurobe-dam.history: Completed in 1963 on the Kurobe River in Toyama Prefecture. Standing at 186 meters, it is Japan's tallest dam and a monumental achievement in post-war hydroelectric engineering along the Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route.

map.flowPath: Outflow discharges through the Kurobe River canyon into the Sea of Japan.

tokuyama-dam.history: Completed in 2008 in Gifu Prefecture across the Ibi River. It forms Japan's largest artificial reservoir by storage volume (660 million m³), providing vital flood control and municipal water for Nagoya and the Chukyo metropolitan area.

map.flowPath: Outflow feeds into the Ibi River, joining the Kiso Three Rivers before reaching Ise Bay.

okutadami-dam.history: Completed in 1960 on the Tadami River on the border of Fukushima and Niigata prefectures. With a height of 157 meters, it is Japan's tallest concrete gravity dam and a powerhouse of clean hydro generation.

map.flowPath: Outflow cascades into the Tadami River, joining the Agano River into the Sea of Japan.

yagisawa-dam.history: Completed in 1967 at the headwaters of the Tone River in Gunma Prefecture. It is the topmost and largest of the eight Tone River dams, serving as the cornerstone of flood control and drinking water for the Greater Tokyo Area.

map.flowPath: Outflow feeds the Tone River, flowing southeast across the Kanto Plain to the Pacific Ocean.

miyagase-dam.history: Completed in 2000 across the Nakatsu River in Kanagawa Prefecture. It is a major multi-purpose concrete gravity dam supplying tap water to two-thirds of Kanagawa Prefecture and offering scenic tourist fountain discharge events.

map.flowPath: Outflow discharges into the Sagami River network and the Lake Miyagase aqueduct.

la-serena-dam.history: Completed in 1989 across the Zújar River in Badajoz, Extremadura. Forming a reservoir of over 3.2 billion cubic meters, it is the largest reservoir in Spain and the third-largest in Western Europe, vital for irrigation in the Vegas Altas.

map.flowPath: Outflow feeds into the Zújar River and discharges into the Guadiana River towards Portugal.

alcantara-dam.history: Completed in 1969 on the Tagus (Tajo) River in Cáceres, Extremadura. Named after the historic Roman bridge downstream, it impounds over 3.1 billion m³ and operates one of the most powerful hydroelectric stations in Spain.

map.flowPath: Outflow continues westward along the Tagus River across the Portuguese border to the Atlantic Ocean.

almendra-dam.history: Completed in 1970 on the Tormes River near Salamanca. Standing 202 meters high, it is the tallest dam in Spain, creating the vast 'Mar de Castilla' reservoir that powers the subterranean Villarino pumped-storage plant.

map.flowPath: Outflow discharges into the Duero (Douro) River canyon.

buendia-dam.history: Completed in 1958 across the Guadiela River in Cuenca. Connected with the Entrepeñas Reservoir through a subterranean canal, it forms the headwater reservoir system for the strategic Tagus-Segura Water Transfer.

map.flowPath: Outflow joins the Tagus River and supplies the Tagus-Segura aqueduct.

mequinenza-dam.history: Completed in 1964 on the Ebro River in Aragon. Known as the 'Mar de Aragón' (Sea of Aragon), it spans over 110 km in length, providing base-load hydroelectric power and flood regulation for the lower Ebro delta.

map.flowPath: Outflow feeds into the Riba-roja reservoir and the Mediterranean Sea.

dartmouth-dam.history: Completed in 1979 on the Mitta Mitta River in Victoria. At 180 meters, it is the highest dam in Australia and the largest capacity reservoir in the Murray-Darling Basin (3,856 GL), serving as critical drought storage for southeastern Australia.

map.flowPath: Outflow flows down the Mitta Mitta River into Hume Reservoir and the Murray River.

hume-dam.history: Constructed between 1919 and 1936 near Albury-Wodonga on the Murray River. It is the primary regulator of the Murray River, providing irrigated agriculture and urban water security across New South Wales, Victoria, and South Australia.

map.flowPath: Outflow flows westward along the Murray River through Yarrawonga to the Southern Ocean.

warragamba-dam.history: Completed in 1960 on the Warragamba River in New South Wales. Holding over 2,000 GL (four times Sydney Harbour), Lake Burragorang behind the dam supplies over 80% of Sydney's drinking water.

map.flowPath: Outflow enters the Nepean River and Hawkesbury River into Broken Bay.

lake-eildon-dam.history: Constructed in the 1950s on the Goulburn River in Victoria. With a capacity of 3,334 GL, it is the cornerstone of the Goulburn-Murray irrigation district, Australia's food bowl.

map.flowPath: Outflow travels along the Goulburn River towards Lake Nagambie and the Murray River.

burdekin-falls-dam.history: Completed in 1987 on the Burdekin River in Queensland. With a massive 1,860 GL capacity, it is Queensland's largest dam, driving the Burdekin River Irrigation Area for sugarcane and horticulture.

map.flowPath: Outflow flows down the Burdekin River into Upstart Bay and the Coral Sea.

belisario-dominguez-la-angostura.history: Completed in 1974 across the Grijalva River in Chiapas. It is the largest dam in Mexico by reservoir capacity (nearly 13 billion m³), anchoring the monumental Grijalva Hydroelectric Complex.

map.flowPath: Outflow cascades downstream through the Sumidero Canyon into Chicoasén and Malpaso reservoirs.

malpaso-nezahualcoyotl.history: Completed in 1966 on the Grijalva River in Chiapas. Holding over 9.6 billion m³, it is Mexico's second largest reservoir and a strategic hydroelectric power generation facility.

map.flowPath: Outflow discharges through Peñitas Dam into the coastal plain of Tabasco and the Gulf of Mexico.

infiernillo-dam.history: Completed in 1964 across the Balsas River on the border of Michoacán and Guerrero. With a capacity of over 9.3 billion m³, it is one of Mexico's greatest rockfill dams, providing critical power and flood control.

map.flowPath: Outflow continues down the Balsas River towards Lázaro Cárdenas on the Pacific Coast.

aguamilpa-dam.history: Completed in 1993 across the Santiago River in Nayarit. At 187 meters high, it is a magnificent concrete-face rockfill dam (CFRD) that impounds 6.95 billion m³ for western Mexico's electrical grid.

map.flowPath: Outflow discharges down the Santiago River to the Pacific Ocean near San Blas.

presa-falcon.history: Dedicated in 1953 by US President Dwight D. Eisenhower and Mexican President Adolfo Ruiz Cortines across the Rio Grande / Río Bravo between Tamaulipas and Texas. It provides transboundary flood control, municipal supply, and irrigation.

map.flowPath: Outflow flows downstream along the lower Rio Grande Valley to the Gulf of Mexico.

history.en: Sameura Dam is a major multipurpose dam on the Yoshino River in Kochi Prefecture, known as the Water Jar of Shikoku. It provides flood control, irrigation, and hydroelectric power.
history.hi: समेउरा बांध कोच्चि प्रान्त में योशिनो नदी पर एक प्रमुख बहुउद्देश्यीय बांध है, जिसे शिकोकू का जल पात्र कहा जाता है।
history.kn: ಸಮೇವುರಾ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಕೊಚ್ಚಿ ಪ್ರಿಫೆಕ್ಚರ್‌ನ ಯೋಶಿನೋ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಬಹುಪಯೋಗಿ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಆಗಿದೆ.
history.te: సమెవురా డ్యామ్ కోచి ప్రిఫెక్చర్‌లోని యోషినో నదిపై నిర్మించిన ప్రధాన బహుళార్థసాధక ప్రాజెక్ట్.
history.ta: சமேவுரா அணை கொச்சி மாகாணத்தில் யோஷினோ ஆற்றின் குறுக்கே கட்டப்பட்ட முக்கியமான பல்நோக்கு அணை.
history.ml: കൊച്ചി പ്രിഫെക്ചറിലെ യോഷിനോ നദിയിൽ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രധാന അണക്കെട്ടാണ് സമേവുര ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Discharges downstream into the Yoshino River across Tokushima.

history.en: Tagokura Dam is a large gravity dam on the Tadami River in Fukushima Prefecture, forming Tagokura Lake and powering one of Japan's largest conventional hydroelectric plants.
history.hi: तागोकुरा बांध फुकुशिमा प्रान्त में तादामी नदी पर एक विशाल गुरुत्वाकर्षण बांध है जो तागोकुरा झील बनाता है।
history.kn: ತಾಗೊಕುರಾ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಫುಕುಶಿಮಾದ ತದಾಮಿ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಗುರುತ್ವಾಕರ್ಷಣಾ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟಾಗಿದೆ.
history.te: తాగోకురా డ్యామ్ ఫుకుషిమాలోని తదామి నదిపై నిర్మించిన భారీ గ్రావిటీ ప్రాజెక్ట్.
history.ta: தாகோகுரா அணை புகுஷிமாவில் உள்ள ததாமி ஆற்றின் குறுக்கே கட்டப்பட்ட பெரிய புவியீர்ப்பு அணை.
history.ml: ഫുകുഷിമയിലെ തദാമി നദിയിൽ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രധാന ഗ്രാവിറ്റി അണക്കെട്ടാണ് താഗോകുര ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Discharges downstream along the Tadami River cascade into Niigata.

history.en: Cíjara Dam is a major reservoir on the Guadiana River in Extremadura, Spain, regulating water storage and irrigation for the Badajoz region.
history.hi: सिहारा बांध स्पेन के एक्स्ट्रेमादुरा में गुआडियाना नदी पर स्थित एक प्रमुख जलाशय है।
history.kn: ಸಿಜಾರಾ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಸ್ಪೇನ್‌ನ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಟ್ರೆಮಡುರಾದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಗ್ವಾಡೀಯಾನಾ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಜಲಾಶಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
history.te: సిజారా డ్యామ్ స్పెయిన్‌లోని గ్వాడియానా నదిపై నిర్మించిన ప్రధాన రిజర్వాయర్.
history.ta: சிஜாரா அணை ஸ்பெயினின் எக்ஸ்ட்ரீமதுராவில் உள்ள குவாடியானா ஆற்றின் குறுக்கே உள்ள பெரிய நீர்த்தேக்கம்.
history.ml: സ്പെയിനിലെ ഗ്വാഡിയാന നദിയിൽ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന പ്രധാന ജലാശയമാണ് സിജാറ ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Feeds downstream into García de Sola and Orellana reservoirs along the Guadiana.

history.en: Iznájar Dam forms the largest reservoir in Andalusia, Spain, located on the Genil River across Córdoba, Granada and Málaga provinces.
history.hi: इज़्नाहार बांध अंडालुसिया में जेनिल नदी पर स्थित स्पेन का एक प्रमुख जलाशय है।
history.kn: ಇಜ್ನಾಜರ್ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಸ್ಪೇನ್‌ನ ಅಂಡಲೂಸಿಯಾದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಜೆನಿಲ್ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಜಲಾಶಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
history.te: ఇజ్నాజార్ డ్యామ్ స్పెయిన్‌లోని జెనిల్ నదిపై నిర్మించబడిన అతిపెద్ద రిజర్వాయర్.
history.ta: இஸ்னாஜார் அணை அந்தலூசியாவில் உள்ள ஜெனில் ஆற்றின் குறுக்கே உள்ள மிகப்பெரிய நீர்த்தேக்கம்.
history.ml: സ്പെയിനിലെ ജെനിൽ നദിയിൽ സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്ന വലിയ അണക്കെട്ടാണ് ഇസ്നാജാർ ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Regulates flow down the Genil River into the main Guadalquivir River channel.

history.en: Lake Argyle Dam (Ord River Dam) is Western Australia's largest body of freshwater, storing 10,760 GL to supply the Ord River Irrigation Area.
history.hi: लेक अर्गाइल बांध पश्चिमी ऑस्ट्रेलिया का सबसे बड़ा मीठे पानी का जलाशय है, जो ऑर्ड नदी पर स्थित है।
history.kn: ಲೇಕ್ ಅರ್ಗೈಲ್ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಪಶ್ಚಿಮ ಆಸ್ಟ್ರೇಲಿಯಾದ ಅತಿದೊಡ್ಡ ಸಿಹಿನೀರಿನ ಜಲಾಶಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
history.te: లేక్ అర్గైల్ డ్యామ్ పశ్చిమ ఆస్ట్రేలియాలోని అతిపెద్ద మంచినీటి రిజర్వాయర్.
history.ta: லேக் அர்கைல் அணை மேற்கு ஆஸ்திரேலியாவின் மிகப்பெரிய நன்னீர் நீர்த்தேக்கம் ஆகும்.
history.ml: പടിഞ്ഞാറൻ ഓസ്ട്രേലിയയിലെ ഏറ്റവും വലിയ ശുദ്ധജല തടാകമാണ് ലേക്ക് അർഗൈൽ ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Discharges downstream into the lower Ord River and Kununurra Diversion Dam.

history.en: Wivenhoe Dam is Queensland's primary drinking water storage and flood mitigation facility on the Brisbane River, supplying greater Brisbane and Ipswich.
history.hi: विवेनहो बांध ब्रिस्बेन नदी पर क्वींसलैंड का प्राथमिक पेयजल भंडारण और बाढ़ नियंत्रण बांध है।
history.kn: ವಿವೆನ್‌ಹೋ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಕ್ವೀನ್ಸ್‌ಲ್ಯಾಂಡ್‌ನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನ ಜಲಾಶಯವಾಗಿದೆ.
history.te: వివెన్‌హో డ్యామ్ క్వీన్స్‌లాండ్‌లోని బ్రిస్బేన్ నదిపై నిర్మించిన ప్రధాన తాగునీటి ప్రాజెక్ట్.
history.ta: விவென்ஹோ அணை குயின்ஸ்லாந்தின் முதன்மை குடிநீர் சேமிப்பு மற்றும் வெள்ளக் கட்டுப்பாட்டு அணை.
history.ml: ക്വീൻസ്‌ലാൻഡിലെ പ്രധാന കുടിവെള്ള സംഭരണിയാണ് വിവെൻഹോ ഡാം.

flowPath.en: Discharges downstream into the Brisbane River towards Moreton Bay.

history.en: Presa La Amistad (Amistad Dam) is a major binational reservoir on the Rio Grande (Río Bravo) on the border between Coahuila, Mexico and Texas, USA, managed by the International Boundary and Water Commission.
history.hi: प्रेसा ला अमिस्ताद मेक्सिको और अमेरिका की सीमा पर रियो ग्रांडे नदी पर स्थित एक प्रमुख द्विपक्षीय बांध है।
history.kn: ಪ್ರೆಸಾ ಲಾ ಅಮಿಸ್ಟಾಡ್ ಮೆಕ್ಸಿಕೊ ಮತ್ತು ಯುಎಸ್ ಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿರುವ ರಿಯೊ ಗ್ರಾಂಡೆ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ದ್ವಿಪಕ್ಷೀಯ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು.
history.te: ప్రెసా లా అమిస్టాడ్ మెక్సికో మరియు అమెరికా సరిహద్దులోని రియో గ్రాండే నదిపై నిర్మించిన ప్రాజెక్ట్.
history.ta: பிரேசா லா அமிஸ்டாட் மெக்ஸிகோ மற்றும் அமெரிக்க எல்லைக்கு இடைப்பட்ட பெரிய இருதரப்பு அணை ஆகும்.
history.ml: മെക്സിക്കോയ്ക്കും യുഎസിനും ഇടയിലുള്ള റിയോ ഗ്രാൻഡെ നദിയിലെ പ്രധാന അണക്കെട്ടാണ് പ്രെസ ലാ അമിസ്റ്റാഡ്.

flowPath.en: Releases water downstream along the international Rio Grande reach towards Presa Falcón.

history.en: Chicoasén Dam (Manuel Moreno Torres) on the Grijalva River in Chiapas is the tallest dam in Mexico (261m) and houses the largest hydroelectric power station in the country (2,400 MW).
history.hi: चिकोआसेन बांध चियापास में ग्रिजल्वा नदी पर स्थित मेक्सिको का सबसे ऊंचा बांध (261 मी) और सबसे बड़ा जलविद्युत स्टेशन है।
history.kn: ಚಿಕೋಅಸೆನ್ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು ಚಿಯಾಪಾಸ್‌ನ ಗ್ರಿಜಾಲ್ವಾ ನದಿಯ ಮೇಲಿರುವ ಮೆಕ್ಸಿಕೊದ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಎತ್ತರದ ಅಣೆಕಟ್ಟು (261 ಮೀ).
history.te: చికోవాసెన్ డ్యామ్ చియాపాస్‌లోని గ్రిజాల్వా నదిపై నిర్మించిన మెక్సికోలోనే అత్యంత ఎత్తైన డ్యామ్ (261 మీ).
history.ta: சிகோவாசென் அணை மெக்சிகோவின் மிக உயரமான அணை (261 மீ) மற்றும் மிகப்பெரிய நீர்மின் நிலையமாகும்.
history.ml: മെക്സിക്കോയിലെ ഏറ്റവും ഉയരമുള്ള അണക്കെട്ടാണ് ചികോസെൻ ഡാം (261 മീറ്റർ).

flowPath.en: Discharges downstream through the Sumidero Canyon cascade into the Malpaso reservoir.
